translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

content.text: Muat na tanga tahut tano Watong, kanong a bilai ie.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Tanga tahut ta God nong i tamat ta ira kaba god bakut.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Tanga tahut tano Watong nong i tamat ta ira kaba watong bakut.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie sen mon i la gilgil ira tamat na pinapalim na kinarup.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong ga gil no mawe ta ira uno minmintot at.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong ga palase no pise aram naliu ta ira taah.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong ga gil ira tamat na lulungo.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: No kasakes i la kurkure no bung na kasakes.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: No teka ma ira tiding diet la kurkure no bung.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong ga bu bing ira matana bulu na tunaan ta ira Isip.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ma ga lamus hasur ira Israel merau nalamin ta diet ira Isip.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ga lamus hasur diet ma no dadas na limana.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong ga paleng no Dardarana Tes nalamin.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ma ga lamus ira Israel nalamin ta ira iruo palpal na tes.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Iesen ga hakango no king me Isip ma ira uno matana ubane tano Dardarana Tes.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong ga lua ta ira uno matanaiabar nalamin tano hanuo bia.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong ga kato bing ira tamat na king.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ma ga bu bing ira dadas na king.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ga bu bing Sihon, no king audiet ira Amor.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ma ga bu bing Og, no king me Basan.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ma i ga tar se ira udiet pise ta ira uno matanaiabar bia diet na tinane leh.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: A haratinan ie taar tano uno tultulai Israel.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Aie nong pa ga lik luban dahat ing dahat ga kis na maris.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ma ga halangalanga dahat sukun ira udahat ebar.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Ma i la tamtabar ira tunotuno ma ira wawaguai bakut ma ra nian.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.

content.text: Muat na tanga tahut tano God nong i kis taar aram ra mawe.

content: No uno harmarsai i kis hathatika.
